description: Turns one to three keywords into about 60 domain name ideas (prefixes, suffixes, blends) plus common endings. Ideas only: availability is not checked.

include_hyphenated.description: Also list hyphenated names (listed last, flagged). Defaults to false.

keywords.description: One to three words describing the idea, such as coffee shop berlin. Only the first three distinct words are used.

name: domain_name_ideas
title: Domain name ideas
